title: MCA Extends Companies Compliance Facilitation Scheme, 2026 (CCFS-2026) till September 15, 2026!
content:
# MCA Extends Companies Compliance Facilitation Scheme, 2026 (CCFS-2026) till September 15, 2026!

Ek important update hai! The Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) ne Companies Compliance Facilitation Scheme, 2026 (CCFS-2026) ki deadline extend kar di hai. This provides companies with additional time to complete their pending statutory filings.

Here are the key details:
*   **Old Due Date:** August 31, 2026
*   **New Due Date:** September 15, 2026
*   **Announcement:** General Circular No. 04/2026 dated August 31, 2026.
*   **Reason:** This extension comes in response to numerous representations from various stakeholders requesting a further continuation of the compliance facilitation window. This new extension supersedes the previous deadline of August 31, 2026. All other terms and conditions of the Scheme remain unchanged.
